exposure: Sexual and/or gender minority parental structures
sexual and/or gender minority parental structures
cohort: Live birth hospitalizations linked to birth certificates in California from 2016 to 2019
finding: Birthing mothers in mother-mother partnerships experienced higher rates of multifetal gestation, labor induction, postpartum hemorrhage, severe morbidity, and nontransfusion severe morbidity compared to birthing mothers in mother-father partnerships, independent of sociodemographic factors, comorbidities, and multifetal gestation.
mod_finding: The study found that birthing mothers in same-sex partnerships experienced higher rates of labor induction, postpartum hemorrhage, and severe morbidity compared to birthing mothers in heterosexual partnerships, but there were no significant differences in cesarean delivery rates.
